claims.label: Experimental section
claims.statement: The source gives a 23–146 nm thickness range.

claims.label: Introduction
claims.statement: The overview gives a 30–146 nm range.

claims.label: Explicit concentration map
claims.statement: The results map 13, 30, 50, 65 and 90 mg/mL to 28, 63, 90, 123 and 146 nm.
claims.locator: Main PDF p. 3, film preparation results

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Use the explicit five-point map for its named specimens; retain all overview endpoints without repairing or averaging them.

claims.label: Experimental recipe
claims.statement: The 10 atom% Sn example uses 0.078 mmol Sn precursor and 0.73 mmol In precursor.

claims.label: Results example
claims.statement: The results describe 0.07 mmol Sn precursor and 0.7 mmol In precursor for 10% Sn NCs.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Keep the full mass/amount recipe and rounded results example separately; do not treat rounding as a second independently demonstrated batch.

claims.label: Abstract and results
claims.statement: The 300 °C, 6 h film is described as 356 ohm/sq.

claims.label: Table 1, Assembly 2
claims.statement: The corresponding nominal condition is tabulated as 358 ohm/sq.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Preserve Table 1 as the tabulated measurement and show the 356 ohm/sq prose value alongside it; do not silently reconcile the small difference.

claims.label: Source text
claims.statement: The main text assigns a 0.91 nm lattice-fringe distance to (222).

claims.label: Source image scope
claims.statement: Figure 1c provides a 5 nm scale bar but does not print a numerical fringe-distance label.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain the literal reported value with an unverified-calibration warning. No substituted spacing is computed or asserted.
